accepted_gaps.because: Sole operator on this repository: the one account that merges cannot approve its own pull request, so a required approval count of 1 would block every merge. Classic branch protection on main requires a pull request (0 approvals) with the strict `sd/local-gate` status, which `sd-ship merge` posts after the check passes at the head, and enforces it for admins. What stands in for a human approval is the review lane: `sd-ship prepare` requires an independent local review from a different vendor than the author, and `sd-ship merge` refuses unacknowledged pull-request review findings.
accepted_gaps.until: a second account with push or merge rights on this repository exists
